visibleTestCases.title: Unlock with Correct Code
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P = door_lock_fsm:start(<<"1234">>), Res = door_lock_fsm:enter_code(P, <<"1234">>), State = door_lock_fsm:get_state(P), door_lock_fsm:stop(P), {Res, State} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Enters correct code, transitions to unlocked state, and confirms state is unlocked.

visibleTestCases.title: Wrong Code Failed Attempts Counter
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P = door_lock_fsm:start(<<"secret">>), Err1 = door_lock_fsm:enter_code(P, <<"wrong1">>), Err2 = door_lock_fsm:enter_code(P, <<"wrong2">>), State = door_lock_fsm:get_state(P), door_lock_fsm:stop(P), {Err1, Err2, State} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Enters incorrect code twice, verifying failed attempts counter increments from 1 to 2.

visibleTestCases.title: Locking and Re-locking State Transitions
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P = door_lock_fsm:start(1111), {ok, unlocked} = door_lock_fsm:enter_code(P, 1111), ok = door_lock_fsm:lock(P), State = door_lock_fsm:get_state(P), door_lock_fsm:stop(P), State end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Unlocks door, locks it again, and confirms state is locked with 0 failed attempts.
